title: Non-human biologics recovered with crashed craft
summary: David Grusch tells of Non-human biologics recovered with crashed craft, about unspecified at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: As I've stated publicly already in my News Nation interview, Biologics came with some of these recoveries.
there are reports that we do have biologics in storage and we just don't know what that is.
tellings.difference: Barber cites unnamed 'reports' and says the biologics are in storage and not understood, without tying them to specific crash recoveries.
tellings.link_reason: Like Grusch's story, this telling claims the US government holds non-human biologics from its secret recovery work.

as_told.title: Reports of biologics held in storage
